what.en: Lines 4a-4b: where the IRS sends the entity's mail; it is generally used on all its tax returns. A P.O. box is fine. A foreign address is accepted: city, province or state, postal code and the country name written out in full.
what.zh: 第4a-4b行：IRS 寄送该实体信件的地址，之后报税一般也沿用此地址。可用邮政信箱。可填境外地址：城市、省或州、邮编，以及国家全称（不可缩写）。

ifNone.en: Use the address where the company actually receives mail, in the US or abroad. A company whose principal place of business is outside the US cannot apply online; it applies by phone, fax or mail.
ifNone.zh: 填写公司实际收信的地址，美国境内或境外均可。主要营业地在美国境外的公司不能在线申请，需通过电话、传真或邮寄申请。

confirmations.quote: Mailing address (room, apt., suite no. and street, or P.O. box)
City, state, and ZIP code (if foreign, see instructions)
If the entity’s mailing address is outside the United States or its territories, you must enter the city, province or state, postal code
Your principal place of business is outside the U.S. If so, apply by phone, fax or mail.

what.en: Lines 5a-5b: the entity's physical address, only if it differs from the mailing address. No P.O. box. A street address abroad is accepted, with the country written out.
what.zh: 第5a-5b行：实体的实际所在地址，仅在与邮寄地址不同时填写。不得填邮政信箱。可填境外街道地址，国家须写全称。

ifNone.en: Leave it blank when the mailing address is already the physical address; otherwise give the street address of the office abroad.
ifNone.zh: 若邮寄地址就是实际地址，此处留空；否则填写境外办公地点的街道地址。

confirmations.quote: Street address (if different) (Don’t enter a P.O. box.)
Provide the entity’s physical address only if different from its mailing address shown on lines 4a–4b. Don’t enter a P.O. box number here.
Your principal place of business is outside the U.S. If so, apply by phone, fax or mail.
Enter the location address only if it is different from Lines 4a-b mailing address. Do not enter a PO Box here.

notes: Form SS-4 (Rev. December 2025) and its instructions (Rev. 12-2025), the IRS 'Get an employer identification number' page and Publication 1635 (Rev. 2-2014). There is no form map for SS-4 yet; field ids follow the task: mailing_address = lines 4a-4b, street_address = lines 5a-5b. The repo's src/forms/pdf/irs-fss4.pdf may be an older revision.
